contract: Only the source-defined t2712 sub5 stream removes its soft bottom target; it keeps policy-volume h6 and common Hard-4 eligibility unchanged. The later sub4/sub3 states remain independent.
summary: The default fail-close run crossed both the earlier t2108 sub2 boundary and the t2388 horizontal band, then stopped alive without HIT or Bomb at f2746. Installed ECL identifies t2712--2842 as an immediate Hard 2x3 aimed fan, distinct from sub4's base 3x2 and sub3's rank-adjusted base 5x2 source instructions. Adjacent physical replay matched all 178 player/combat transitions. On eleven exact roots, target-free h6 survived 11/11 versus bottom-target h6 10/11, using 6.36 versus 22.09 mean commands. At the f2713 root, the first policy divergence was f2723; target-free survived 64 frames with five commands while bottom-target stopped after 53 with sixteen. A 32-case warmup generated 25 complete worlds through 940 updates and 4017 births. On 30 viable 96-frame delivery cases, target-free survived 28 versus 26, won four paired seeds and lost two, gained 129 aggregate survival frames, used 684 fewer commands, and had higher mean minimum clearance. This selects a target-free physical falsifier, not a claim of universal dominance.
